scope: Read-only review of guided recovery, unknown mask fusion, loss attribution, secondary evaluator and receipts. Only this review artifact was written.

resolved_findings.problem: Per-point majority semantic diagnostic was labeled class-aware recall even when inference exported mixed objects as semantic_id 0.
resolved_findings.verified_fix: Lines 104-112 use exact exported objects.json instance IDs and semantic IDs; lines 146-151 separately report explicitly posthoc majority-semantic metrics and exported object-semantic recall. Input hashes include objects.json. Five prior receipts preserved and five new receipts checked.

resolved_findings.problem: Documentation implied one ambiguous shared mask vetoed the entire guide, while code excluded only that frame from positive support.
resolved_findings.verified_fix: Documentation now explicitly says other unambiguous frames may support the guide. No algorithm change needed.

verification.targeted_tests: 17 passed: tests/test_sam3_guided.py and tests/test_sam3_loss_unknown.py, before documentation/evaluator-only clarification; tests not rerun for clarification.
verification.frame_safety: Both guided and multiview reject duplicate frame IDs and duplicate point IDs in one frame; each projected point has one local mask per frame.
verification.source_receipts_match: Frozen guided runner/module copies and unknown runner/modules matched inspected source SHA-256 receipts.
verification.loss_audit: Captures actual backend locals and verifies byte-identical expected R3 output; exclusive deepest-stage attribution is explicitly not counterfactual causation.

interpretation_limits: No guarantee of physical object purity or absence of pre-existing physical merges. Guided preserves R3 numeric owners; multiple C guides may expand one R3 anchor (0030: 39 recovered guides into 34 destinations; 0011: 18 into 15; 0050: 14 into 13).
Guided 0030 versus R3 class-agnostic recall is unchanged at IoU 0.25 and 0.5; eligible-GT coverage increases about 0.199 percentage points.

Unknown-object arms preserve the pointwise semantic map and explicitly leave mixed objects unnamed. Their actual exported object-semantic recall is 2/27 at both thresholds on 0030; later naming is a separate unexecuted stage.
The secondary evaluator is a fixed-alignment, recognized-GT-domain diagnostic, not official ScanNet AP or a blind holdout.
Three-RScan evidence is six cached frames, not full-scene validation; CPU arms reuse cached inference and do not constitute new SAM3/SGA inference or full raw RGB-D tracking.
